# Lead Roster

> Lead Roster is a free directory of certified lead-based paint inspectors, risk assessors and abatement firms in New Jersey, New York and Massachusetts, built from NJ DCA, US EPA and Massachusetts licence records.

Lead Roster is for landlords, tenants, buyers and parents who need a certified lead inspector, risk assessor or abatement contractor. Listings come from NJ DCA certified contractor lists, the US EPA lead-based paint firm locator (New York) and the Massachusetts licensed lead inspector list, retrieved 2026-10-12. Every page has a Markdown version: replace the trailing slash with `.md` (home: https://leadpaintroster.com/index.md).

## States
- [New Jersey](https://leadpaintroster.com/nj/): New Jersey Department of Community Affairs licence records
- [New York](https://leadpaintroster.com/ny/): US Environmental Protection Agency licence records
- [Massachusetts](https://leadpaintroster.com/ma/): Commonwealth of Massachusetts (licensed private lead inspector list) licence records
